<a id="k-diagnostic"></a>
### `k.Diagnostic` *(class)*

```python
k.Diagnostic(
    code: str,
    level: Level,
    message: str,
    spans: list[Span] = <factory>,
    span_notes: list[str] = <factory>,
    time: float | None = None,
    objects: list[str] = <factory>,
    fixes: list[Fix] = <factory>,
)
```

Diagnostics are read with `kinemo check` and `kinemo explain <code>`.

**Parameters:**

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `code` | `str` | required |   |
| `level` | `Level` | required |   |
| `message` | `str` | required |   |
| `spans` | `list[Span]` | `<factory>` |   |
| `span_notes` | `list[str]` | `<factory>` |   |
| `time` | `float \| None` | `None` |   |
| `objects` | `list[str]` | `<factory>` |   |
| `fixes` | `list[Fix]` | `<factory>` |   |

**Members:**

- [`json`](#diagnostic-json): The diagnostic as the stable JSON object of `kinemo check --json`.
- [`render`](#diagnostic-render): The diagnostic as terminal text: code, message, source lines, instant and fixes.

### `k.KinemoError` *(class)*

